evaluation_rounds.question: On a disjoint research panel, do the late-transition and final checkpoints sustain their measured reach-and-hold performance, and does the unmeasured checkpoint-100352 training-success peak provide a better candidate for closure?
evaluation_rounds.reason: The current best measured candidates, checkpoint-95232 and checkpoint-120832, each achieved 151/160 (94.375%) on the same research panel used to select them, while the fixed task-reference panel reached 96% and 97% respectively but cannot provide independent confirmation. The official objective is at least 98%, so closure should not rely on those non-independent scores. checkpoint-100352 is unmeasured yet has the highest recorded training success (0.97), making it an informative alternative. A disjoint panel can confirm whether the measured candidates generalize and can change which checkpoint is retained for closure.
